summary: Duplicati 2.4.1.1 mostly fixes restores, repair, SMB, and Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace backups, and its web UI can now compare two versions of a backup. Backups to a local folder now upload one volume at a time, and a backup stops when a source folder cannot be read. The database format is unchanged, so going back to 2.4.1.0 needs no downgrade.
